sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence for clinical oncology》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Clinical oncology is experiencing rapid growth in data that are collected to enhance cancer care.

evidence.text: Clinical oncology is experiencing rapid growth in data that are collected to enhance cancer care.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence for clinical oncology》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】With recent advances in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), there is now a computational basis to integrate and synthesize this growing body of multi-dimensional data, deduce patterns, and predict outcomes to improve shared patient and clinician decision making.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We also suggest paths forward in weaving AI into individualized patient care, with an emphasis on clinical validity, utility, and usability.

evidence.text: With recent advances in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), there is now a computational basis to integrate and synthesize this growing body of multi-dimensional data, deduce patterns, and predict outcomes to improve shared patient and clinician decision making.
We also suggest paths forward in weaving AI into individualized patient care, with an emphasis on clinical validity, utility, and usability.
